postPatchSql: UPDATE chat_scripts SET status='active' WHERE status='draft' AND "packId" IS NULL
releaseNotes:
vmfix30 — 6 fixes + Tier 2 patch infrastructure

1. (A5 CRITICAL) Specify-Script dropdown now correctly shows builtin packs + self-built scripts. Root cause: findAll() filtered by tenantId equality, excluding tenantId IS NULL (builtin + legacy self-built). Now uses (tenantId = caller OR tenantId IS NULL) — matches pickRandom + listPacks behavior.
2. (A6) create() now auto-injects caller's tenantId so future self-built scripts are properly tenant-scoped (was leaving them NULL = visible to all tenants).
3. (A1) Self-built scripts default status DRAFT → ACTIVE so they appear immediately without separate activation step.
4. (A2) create() defensively falls back to status=ACTIVE in case entity default changes again.
5. (A3) listPacks now filters by tenant (no more cross-tenant pack name leak).
6. (A4) supervisor heartbeat now detects dead child processes and auto-restarts (max 3 attempts) — agent will no longer silently disappear.
7. Patch infrastructure introduced: future fixes ship as 5-10 MB zip via Apply-Patch.ps1 instead of full 145 MB installer.

This patch automatically activates any DRAFT chat scripts you created before upgrading.
